glossary.ja: クインシィ・グランチャー
glossary.role: Quincy Issa's red custom Grand Cher

glossary.ja: アーミー・グランチャー
glossary.role: Grand Cher flown by US military forces occupying Orphan

glossary.ja: ターミネーターポリス
glossary.role: TS-TP-50D, unmanned Grados Terror Striker developed from the Skull Gunner and used to hunt Earth's resistance; capable of acrobatic maneuvers. Enemy unit.
Hijacked mass-production Aestivalis controlled by Jovian Batta (enemy unit)

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Zentradi general-issue powered suit (DYRL design).
Gon Jem's irregular unit, nicknamed the "Filth of Giganos"
Aura battleship of Bishot Hatta, King of Ku; an enemy ship in Operation 25.
Self-evolving, self-repairing, self-replicating rogue Gundam (JDG-00X); main antagonist machine of G Gundam
AMX-002 (AMA-X2), giant Zeon mobile armor flown by Gato in the finale.
Anti-Orphan battleship (carrier with a pyramid superstructure); base of the Brain Powerd pilots
Modified Gun Ark with an evolving Guardian System and fallen-angel styling; Marina's unit while with the Rainen side.
Orphan-loyal Antibody piloted by Reclaimers (generic grunt unit)
Upgraded Jovian Tetsujin (Tsukumo; later Takasugi)
Jovian gate-ships that spawn enemy units; targets of missions like チューリップ掃討 / チューリップ排除.
SPT-DM-20C, high-mobility mass-production Grados SPT (Karla Egiel's unit; widely used during the Earth occupation). Enemy unit.
Class of Drake-side aura ship; a weaker cousin of the aura battleships.
MSC-07 Pegasus-class Federation assault carrier commanded by Sinapus.
Daba's white A-class Heavy Metal, a Yaman-built mecha. Later piloted by Amu.
MS-14F, marine-corps Gelgoog flown by the Cima Fleet.
Upgraded Jovian Majin (Tsukiomi)
AFA-03 Dowtwen, Giganos atmospheric unit halfway between Metal Armor and Folg
MS-21C, Delaz Fleet assault suit built from Zaku II F2 bodies and Gattle fighter parts.
Dotless form of バロン・ズゥ: Jonathan's/Quincy's powerful Antibody (also 巨大バロンズゥ).

glossary.series: Blue Comet SPT Layzner (NOT this group)
glossary.role: SPT-BV-15C Braver, a Grados SPT (grunt). It appears among the Layzner units in the ACE2 unit list (between Dargen and Eldar), and a mission objective reads 'destroy all Braver and Dimage'

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Zentradi officer/commander battle pod.
Zeon's main mass-production mobile suit (MS-06).
Jovian 'new weapon' (micro black hole railgun) that the player must destroy (mission 新型兵器ナナフシ).
God Gundam's higher state (明鏡止水モード) reached when Domon's heart attains a serene mind.

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: TV: cook and Aestivalis pilot of the Nadesico, a Class-A Boson Jumper. PoD: the "Prince of Darkness", Black Sarena pilot hunting the Martian Successors
glossary.personality: TV: kind, reluctant and insecure Gekiganger fan who wants to be a cook. PoD: cold, grim and vengeful after experiments destroyed his senses

glossary.role: FMA-04A Dyne, standard Giganos mass-production Metal Armor
Original Aestivalis pilot of the Nadesico (real name Jiro Yamada); killed early in the TV series
glossary.personality: Loud, hot-blooded, obsessed with Gekiganger III; insists Gai is his soul's name
